tasks.subject: Explore project context
tasks.description: Check existing files, docs, recent commits in the foundry directory to understand current state before designing.

tasks.subject: Ask clarifying questions
tasks.description: Ask one question at a time to understand purpose, constraints, success criteria for the digital identity / verifiable credentials service.

tasks.subject: Propose 2-3 approaches
tasks.description: Present architectural approaches with trade-offs and a recommendation.

tasks.subject: Present design sections
tasks.description: Present the design in sections scaled to complexity; get user approval after each section.

tasks.subject: Write design doc
tasks.description: Save validated design to docs/superpowers/specs/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>-design.md and commit.

tasks.subject: Spec self-review
tasks.description: Inline check for placeholders, contradictions, ambiguity, scope. Fix issues inline.

tasks.subject: User reviews spec
tasks.description: Ask user to review the written spec file before proceeding to implementation planning.

tasks.subject: Transition to implementation (writing-plans)
tasks.description: Invoke the writing-plans skill to create the implementation plan. Terminal state of brainstorming.
